انتزعنا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَزَعْنَا (intazaʕnā) /in.ta.zaʕ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# اُنْتُزِعْنَا (untuziʕnā) /un.tu.ziʕ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
